plugins.name: ftc-code-authoring
plugins.description: Write and debug FTC SDK code — OpMode lifecycle (init/loop/stop), hardware-map device access, LinearOpMode vs. iterative OpMode, TeleOp and Autonomous structure, and the hardware-map pitfalls that cause the most FTC runtime crashes. Use when authoring a new OpMode, converting between OpMode styles, or debugging a "Config mismatch" / ClassCastException / NullPointerException thrown by the Robot Controller app.
